Common questions

Frequently asked questions

What fabric varieties are available at Samruddhi Fabrics?

Samruddhi Fabrics offers a range of greige fabric varieties, including Maslin, BSYD (Bi-Shrinkage Yarn Fabric), S.Cane, Rayon, and Waffle. Each variety has its own construction and characteristics to suit different textile manufacturing requirements.

Can I get fabric specifications before placing an order?

Yes, you can contact our team to discuss the specifications relevant to your chosen fabric, such as GSM, width, weave construction, and yarn composition. Our team can help clarify the available specifications for the product you require.

Can I request a specific fabric construction or GSM?

Fabric requirements depend on the product and its manufacturing possibilities. Share your preferred construction, GSM, width, and other technical requirements with our team to check whether they can be accommodated.

What information should I provide when enquiring about a fabric?

For a more efficient enquiry, share the fabric variety, required GSM, width, yarn composition, quantity, and intended application, wherever applicable. You can also provide a reference sample or technical specification sheet to help communicate your requirements clearly.

Does Samruddhi Fabrics accept bulk orders?

For bulk requirements, contact our team with the fabric variety, estimated quantity, and required specifications. We can discuss your needs and confirm availability and production feasibility.

How do I get a quotation for my fabric requirements?

You can contact the Samruddhi Fabrics team with your preferred fabric category, specifications, and estimated quantity. Based on the information provided, our team can discuss availability, pricing, and applicable order requirements.

What factors determine the price of greige fabric?

Pricing can depend on several factors, including yarn composition, fabric construction, GSM, width, order quantity, and prevailing raw-material costs. Providing your exact requirements helps our team prepare a more relevant quotation.

Can I source different fabric varieties from Samruddhi Fabrics?

Samruddhi offers multiple fabric categories, including Maslin, BSYD, S.Cane, Rayon, and Waffle. Contact our team with your requirements across these categories to discuss product availability and the feasibility of sourcing them together.
